propositions: MCP unlink_tickets does not accept an optional relation parameter despite the public library and CLI supporting relation-scoped edge removal
The FastMCP schema advertises only id1 and id2, preventing callers from selecting which edge to remove when a ticket pair holds multiple relations

The unlink_tickets callable omits both the parameter declaration and the forwarding of relation to rebar.unlink, causing pair-scoped fallback behavior (removing newest edge) instead of requested relation
When relation is omitted, the documented pair-scoped most-recent fallback must be preserved unchanged
Write-surface parity across library, CLI, and MCP must be total with zero intended divergences per the restoring-shallow-blobfish ruling
